name: Hillsbrad Human Skull
summary: Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, Forsaken gather the skulls of slain humans. At Tarren Mill, they keep them as grim mementos of the assault on local settlements.

sections.title: Trophies of a Bitter War
sections.body: Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill fight the humans of Southshore and nearby settlements. During the Battle of Hillsbrad, Deathstalkers and soldiers carry out the purge Darthalia ordered. Guards left on watch want a share of the slaughter. Deathguard Samsa collects skulls from the fighters on the front lines, taking pleasure in keeping the remains of people the Forsaken once lived among. These trophies are proof of the killing as the conflict rages.

faq.answer: Deathguard Samsa, a Forsaken sentry at Tarren Mill, collects the skulls. Envious of soldiers sent to battle and pillage Hillsbrad while he remains on guard, he asks passing adventurers to bring him thirty for his private collection.

faq.q: Where are Hillsbrad Human Skulls gathered?
faq.answer: Forsaken gather the skulls from human combatants and laborers across the Hillsbrad Foothills, especially near the human-held farms, mines, and town fortifications attacked during the Battle of Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken collect human remains?
faq.answer: Some Forsaken collect human remains out of hatred and dark humor. Soldiers like Samsa treat the skulls as prized curiosities and proof that Hillsbrad is nearing defeat.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you may see the skulls as vengeance and a grim reminder of the living kin who shun you.
As an Alliance member, you see Hillsbrad's farmers and soldiers reduced to trinkets, a sign of the Forsaken campaign's cruelty in Lordaeron.
